  bxor = function(a, b)
    local r, p = 0, 1
    while a > 0 or b > 0 do
      local ra, rb = a % 2, b % 2
      if ra ~= rb then r = r + p end
      a, b, p = math.floor(a / 2), math.floor(b / 2), p * 2
    end
    return r
  end
}

local _0xCACHE = {}
local function _0xSTR(idx)
  if _0xCACHE[idx] then return _0xCACHE[idx] end
  local bytes = _0xPOOL[idx + 1]
  local key = _0xKEYS[idx + 1]
  if not bytes then return "" end
  local chars = {}
  for i = 1, #bytes do
    local decByte = _0xBIT32.bxor(bytes[i], key)
    chars[i] = string.char(decByte)
  end
  local result = table.concat(chars)
  _0xCACHE[idx] = result
  return result
end
